PSWindows

PS C:\Users\Admin> $Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle = "iamt-corpus-title"
PS C:\Users\Admin> Write-Host "coloured" -ForegroundColor Green
coloured
PS C:\Users\Admin> Write-Output "Πριβετ μιρ "
Πριβετ μιρ
PS C:\Users\Admin> exit
